features.label: Came back from the floor
features.detail: Cocaine, obesity, and suicidal depression, then the heavyweight title again. Documented, not mythologized.

features.label: Says it out loud
features.detail: Rare in a sport built on projected invulnerability. That candour is the actual contribution.

features.label: Has said ugly things
features.detail: Public comments about women and LGBT people are on record. Honest study does not skip them.
